description: This file defines an abstract base class 'FormatterBase' for Drupal field formatter plugins, including constructor, view rendering, and configuration methods.

classes.name: FormatterBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for field formatter plugins in Drupal, providing common functionality for rendering and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the FormatterBase with field definition, settings, label, view mode, and third-party settings.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of the formatter using dependency injection.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Renders the field items, applying cacheability metadata and theme info.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns an empty array for formatter settings form.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Returns an empty array summarizing settings.

methods.name: prepareView
methods.description: Placeholder method for preparing view, to be implemented by subclasses.

methods.name: getFieldSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific field setting by name.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Checks if the formatter is applicable to a given field definition; defaults to true.
